text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National Assembly speaker sends letters to world organisations stressing that the Turkish invasion of northern Iraq violates Iraqi sovereignty.
- Sudanese farmers send telegram of support to President Saddam Hussein.
- World condemnation of Turkish invasion of northern Iraq continues.
- Vice-President Taha Mohieddin Ma'rouf receives Sudanese ambassador.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz receives Russian official.
- Ship loaded with cooking oil arrives at Umm Qasr.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Commentary on U.S. persistence to inflict more harm on Iraqi people.
- Commentary says the 21st century will see the waning of U.S. influence in the world.
- Article on on U.S. aggression and hostile attitudes towards Iraq.
- Article on the benefits of the next census to be conducted end of year.
